market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver would need to rise about 3.6x in ~14 months, more than double its all-time high of $50. No historical precedent or fundamental catalyst supports such a move. The true probability is negligible, roughly 0.5%, far below the market's 6.6% implied chance.
evidence_points: Silver ATH is ~$50/oz; $120 is 2.4x that level.
No plausible supply or demand shock could quadruple silver in a year without an economic meltdown.
CME silver futures reflect physical reality; speculative spikes historically peak well below $120.
